build_coarse_segm_mask: build a python module to convert coarse segmentation predictor output to BitMasks using predictor_output_with_coarse_segm_to_mask
build_fine_coarse_segm_mask: build a python module to convert fine and coarse segmentation predictor output to BitMasks using predictor_output_with_fine_and_coarse_segm_to_mask
resample_coarse_segm_to_bbox: resample a coarse segmentation tensor to a bounding box and derive per-pixel labels using resample_coarse_segm_tensor_to_bbox
resample_fine_coarse_segm_to_bbox: resample fine and coarse segmentation tensors to a bounding box and derive combined per-pixel labels using resample_fine_and_coarse_segm_tensors_to_bbox
resample_predictor_output_to_bbox: resample DensePose predictor output segmentation results to a bounding box using resample_fine_and_coarse_segm_to_bbox
